inputs.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a children's paint-by-numbers game, age four and up. A delightful colorful acoustic guitar and a separate round tambourine, arranged diagonally in one balanced playful composition on a pure white background. The guitar has a recognizable curvy hourglass body: broad coral-red upper shoulders and golden-yellow lower body divided by a smooth sweeping boundary, a thick turquoise rim around one circular dark soundhole, a small brown bridge and a slender proportionate warm-brown neck with a rounded blue headstock and six simple orange tuning pegs. Three fine straight black string lines connect bridge to headstock continuously; not giant black stripes or a rectangular colored plank. The guitar leans gently to the right. Beside it on the lower left is one tilted circular tambourine with a broad grass-green wooden frame and five clearly attached golden jingle pairs, open white center, visually separate from guitar. A folded purple fabric ribbon tied simply to the tambourine has two broad curved tails, giving another large color area; no intricate folds or patterns. Strong recognizable instrument construction, friendly rounded shapes but NO anthropomorphic faces, no eyes or mouths. Broad enclosed flat-color areas, thick clean uniform black outlines, complete objects inside generous white margins, minimalist coherent composition. No shadows, gradients, texture, musical notes, text, numbers, hands, extra instruments or duplicated parts.
